quantification_protocol.sampling: With replacement within true class; identical bags for every method; grid equally weighted
quantification_protocol.calibration: Half of the original test rows calibrate confusion; the disjoint half supplies bags. Reverse-direction sensitivity at n=500. Base classifiers unchanged.
quantification_protocol.scope: Retrospective secondary diagnostic on a previously inspected test set; not a new independent benchmark or target-domain correction.
quantification_protocol.matrices_orientation: rows predicted class, columns true class; order negative, neutral, positive

historical.interval_scope: 10000 resamples of 14 observed day means; seed42; assumes exchangeable days; descriptive, not population inference or classification-correctness uncertainty.
